title: LPBench Benchmark Definition
description: A versioned benchmark definition that owns the prompt, required files, viewport definitions, and benchmark-specific constraints. Provider-specific behavior must not be encoded here (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

name.description: Human-readable benchmark name, e.g. 'SaaS Landing Page'.

version.description: SemVer benchmark version. A benchmark version is immutable once published with results (docs/BENCHMARK_DESIGN.md).

requiredFiles.description: Artifact files the generated run must produce.

viewports.description: Viewport definitions used for responsive evaluation and screenshots.

rubricPath.description: Optional path (relative to the benchmark directory) to the rubric.json for this version.

promptPath.description: Optional path (relative to the benchmark directory) to the prompt for this version.
